answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable jade stake before it can trade. The stake is a bond, not a fee: an honest agent gets it back, while a fake identity caught cheating loses it. Because each identity costs real capital, one attacker cannot cheaply spawn thousands of sock puppets to wander the market rigging prices; the raven of detection — reputation audits that sample random trades — makes each fake account a liability rather than a free vote. Forging identities stops being profitable once the stake exceeds the gain from a single scam.
